label: Text element
when: a piece of text inside a list item or a counter (for ordinary text on a page use heading and paragraph instead)
rules: A text element with no HTML of its own, self-closing. Use it only inside a spectra list item or counter, as their examples show. For any other text on a page write heading and paragraph blocks, never this block. "text" is plain text, no HTML tags. Always "isRootBlock":false. "tagName" is the element: p (the default, leave it out) for a sentence, h3 or h4 for a short title, span for a few words. "textColor" is a palette slug. Set nothing else.
example:
<!-- wp:spectra/content {"tagName":"h4","text":"Puncture repair","isRootBlock":false} /-->

<!-- wp:spectra/content {"text":"We find the hole, patch the tube and check the tyre before you leave.","isRootBlock":false} /-->
